api_endpoints.description: Get a specific point by ID
Search for nearest points by vector similarity
Insert or update points in a collection
Create a new collection with specified vector configuration and HNSW index parameters

endpoint_registry.doc_quote: Get a specific point by ID
Search for nearest points by vector similarity
Insert or update points in a collection
Create a new collection with specified vector configuration and HNSW index parameters

type_constraints.description: vectors.distance must be one of: Cosine, Euclidean, Dot, Manhattan
vector dimension must match collection dimension

state_constraints.description: Collection creation is atomic - fails if collection already exists
Collection deletion is atomic - fails if collection does not exist
Upsert is atomic per point - concurrent upserts by same ID are serialized
Search is consistent with completed upserts
Delete points operation is atomic and serialized

assertions.description: Invalid parameters or existing collection returns 400 Bad Request
Non-existent collection deletion returns 404 Not Found
Invalid upsert (non-existent collection) returns 404 Not Found
assertions.expected_behavior: returns 404 Not Found if collection missing

assertions.description: Valid search returns 200 OK with scored results
assertions.expected_behavior: returns 200 OK with array of scored points

assertions.description: Empty collection search returns empty array (no error)
Missing points selector returns 400 Bad Request
assertions.expected_behavior: returns 400 Bad Request if neither points nor filter specified

assertions.description: Existing point returns 200 OK with point data
Valid scroll returns 200 OK with batch of points

behavioral_contracts.scenario: Create collection and upsert points, then immediately query
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Newly created collection and upserted points are immediately visible to subsequent queries (no artificial delay)

behavioral_contracts.scenario: Delete collection or points, then immediately query
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Deleted collection/points are immediately invisible to subsequent queries (returns 404 or empty results)

behavioral_contracts.scenario: Concurrent upserts to same point ID
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Concurrent updates to same point are serialized - final state reflects one complete update, no partial/corrupted state

state_invariants.description: After creating a collection, it should be visible in collection list and retrievable via GET
After deleting a collection, it should not exist and should not be retrievable
state_invariants.assertion: delete_collection(c) => NOT exists(c) AND get_collection(c) returns 404

state_invariants.description: After inserting N points, count query should return N
After upserting a point, it should be searchable

data_types.name: Dense Vector
data_types.description: Array of floating-point numbers with fixed dimension

data_types.name: Point
data_types.description: Single data point with vector and optional payload

data_types.name: Collection Config
data_types.description: Collection configuration with vector params and HNSW settings
